description: Actively seeking roles within large-scale backend environments. Currently architecting modular SaaS systems and refining Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices to build highly maintainable and production-ready infrastructure.

Architected and delivered an end-to-end multi-tenant SaaS platform. Managed the entire lifecycle—from database schema design and RESTful API development to frontend integration. Successfully validated product-market fit through direct field research and iterative deployments, thereby gaining deep expertise in operational workflow design.

Engineered scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript. Developed and maintained robust RESTful APIs, payment gateway integrations, and complex business workflow modules. Focused on performance optimization and database reliability within high-traffic production environments.

Gained foundational experience in professional software engineering. Assisted in the development and debugging of production-grade APIs, database schema migrations, and core backend service implementations within a collaborative Agile environment.
